note: DP-24 (c) (P-D1-3): background shells survive /clear, so in a successor after /clear (the origin's process is alive and now runs C, lineage C -> origin, clear) a job with no end marker is RUNNING (V2 fails: owner process still live after /clear), REFUSED: running with no ask-command, never LOST or relaunched. DP-24 (b) (P-D1-2): the runtime trailer `[exited with code N]`, written without a newline, is an end marker (rc 0 -> DONE-UNREPORTED, collect); `[killed]` (TaskStop or the stop at exit) is KILLED: REFUSED: killed with the recorded ask-command, also with a recorded stop and also after an exit. wait exit: prints rc= for the trailer and `killed` for `[killed]`
